Display.doc: On a conversational request, open the requested application page through authorized UI presentation. Touch navigation is local and does not call this Agent.

Robot.doc: Perform the requested finite gesture using motors1–5, starting and ending at their home; never command or wait for the gripper. Accept optional native speed1–1400 and acceleration1–254. Stable arrival advances immediately. Stable off-target positions, send errors and missing feedback end only affected atomic steps and are collected in the final report; subsequent composition steps and Channel actions continue. Unavailable-device steps fail without blind writes, queries or replay. Explicit cancellation stops remaining work. Use only on user request with a connected arm and clear space.

function.name: ModelResources.snapshot
function.description: Read current shared model resource inventory, installed groups and progress. Does not download, remove or switch a model.

function.name: Provider.readSettings
function.description: Read confirmed cloud-enabled status and selected cloud model. Contains no URL/key. Does not probe provider availability or change configuration.

function.name: Bluetooth.readStatus
function.description: Read current Bluetooth power/connection and discovered device IDs. Does not scan or move a robot.

function.name: Bluetooth.control
function.description: Submit an explicit Bluetooth connection/discovery command. Accepted is not connected or physically completed. Read status to confirm actual state.

function.name: App.readEnvironment
function.description: Read latest sequenced scene, navigation and device capability facts admitted by the root Agent. Facts are observations, not proof of physical completion.

function.name: ModelResources.download
function.description: Admit a model download using an explicit source. Admission does not mean installed; read the shared inventory for progress.

function.name: ModelResources.cancel
function.description: Cancel and join an admitted model transfer. Failure is returned without replay.
